answer: Every identity must post a refundable bond into a shared kernel registry before it can trade. New agents enter only through a narrow inlet: a few admissions per epoch, each sponsored by an established agent who shares the slash risk if the newcomer cheats. Until then they work on a quarantined island shard, transacting only with other newcomers until verified work earns them full access. A Sybil flood then costs one bond per fake identity plus a sponsor stake, while honest agents recover their bond.
